description: GRC BootAble: Creates bootable FreeDOS media to check whether a PC can boot a BIOS/legacy environment.
notes: GRC does not publish a static SHA-256 checksum for this download. The manifest omits hash rather than inventing a value.

Creating bootable media writes to the target drive. Secure Boot may need to be disabled and legacy/CSM boot enabled; GRC warns that disabling Secure Boot while BitLocker is active can trigger recovery-key requirements. Verify BitLocker status and back up recovery keys before changing firmware settings.

script: if (-not $match.Success) { throw 'Unable to read the published Last Updated date for BootAble.' }
